title: Wolf Adventure Pack, format 1
description: The whole of one adventure as data. Contract: ADVENTURE_PACK_V1.md. The brain (BRAIN_API_V1.md) is the one validator: this schema checks shape; wolfadventure_lib.php wa_validate_pack() also checks every cross-reference (ADVENTURE_PACK_V1.md section 'Cross-reference rules').

revision.description: Set by the brain on publish (wolfadv_pack_revisions.revision). Ignored on upload.

parcels.description: Loot and reward bundles ('parcels' in the GM sense, not land parcels).

endings.description: [GAME CARD 2026-10-18] At least one, except a roleplay game (adventure.card.shape "roleplay"), which may have none.

flow.description: The Studio's story map (WolfViewer page 3): where the author dragged each box, in chart units (its top left, x right, y down). Keyed "b:<beat id>" or "e:<ending id>"; a box with no entry is laid out automatically. Kept at the top level so a moved box does not count as an author's change of the beat itself (was_hash).

imports.description: Where this pack came from, for the Studio's 'imported from' line. Never read by the runtime.

id.description: A pack-local id: lower case letter first, then letters, digits, _ or -. Unique within its own list (cross-reference rules).

vec3.description: Region metres <x, y, z>. z 0 means 'on the ground or floor under x, y' (the STORY v1 rule, wolf_storyteller.lsl standAt).

id.description: Set by the brain (wolfadv_adventures.adventure_uuid). Ignored on upload.

rating.description: General, Moderate or Adult; must not be above any listed region's maturity (RegionSettings.Maturity 0/1/2, Util.ConvertMaturityToAccessLevel). Education packs must be general.

language.description: BCP 47 tag of the pack's own text, e.g. en-GB.

story.description: The story the author keeps and builds the game from (STORY_FIRST_DESIGN.md section 4): their own written story, or a book's AI summary. Never read by the runtime; the Studio's "Build it" and the helper read it.

card.description: [GAME CARD 2026-10-18] The game card (GAME_CARD_SPINE_SPEC.md section 1): who the player is, the one-line goal, how they win and lose, the shape, length, players and genre. Shown at the top of the Studio pages and on the HUD (goal). For shape "roleplay" there is no win or lose and `goal` is what the game is about.

goal.description: The one-line goal (for roleplay: what it is about).

lose.description: How you lose ("" = you cannot lose, you keep trying).

length.description: short = about 15 minutes, medium = about 45 minutes, long = 2 hours or more.

cover.description: Texture UUID for the Studio / Experiences card.

look.description: The adventure's look for players (AUDIT_2026-10-17 section 5.3): a logo for the Adventures list and the HUD, the HUD and talk panel colours, and a title card shown when a player starts. Every texture must exist on the grid's asset service as a texture; accent on panel must be at least 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3). Checked by the brain.

logo.description: A square texture shown in the Adventures list and on the HUD's objective plate.

accent.description: The HUD and talk panel accent (titles, rims, the chosen button).

panel.description: The HUD and talk panel background. Text on it is white or black, whichever reads better.

titleCard.description: Shown to a player when they start the adventure (a stage 'title' cue with an image).

title.description: The card's big line; empty = the adventure's title.

regions.description: The regions this adventure runs on. A region is ENABLED only after its holder approves it (BRAIN_API_V1.md enable_region).

npcBudget.description: Most Director NPCs this adventure may have on this region at once. Clamped by the region's own budget (REGION_HANDS_V1.md 'NPC budget').

mode.description: party: separate progress per party; shared: one story for everyone on the region; both: a shared world (scenes marked shared) with per-party quests. Plan section 7.3.

join.description: open: anyone may start or join; invite: the party leader invites; class: only members of a class session (education).

repeat.description: May a player start again after an ending? Rewards marked once stay once (STORY v1 repeat:).

auto.description: Runs by itself with the AI Director (or rules only in non-AI mode) whenever no GM is in charge. Plan section 4a: true by default.

liveGm.description: A granted GM may take over.

callGm.description: Players may ask for a GM; online GMs get a ping.

schedule.description: Booked GM sessions (Wolf Experiences / events). Outside them the adventure runs in Auto.

beat.description: The beat a new party starts on.

trigger.description: How a player starts: talking to a cast member (RDR2 'missions start from conversation'), arriving in an area, or from the HUD's Adventures list.

experiences.description: List it in Wolf Experiences (php/experiences.php submissions).

nowLine.description: The 'what's happening now' line, refreshed by the brain.

attribution.description: Third-party works this pack uses. The brain ADDS the rules preset's own attribution (RULES_PRESETS_V1.md) on publish; a pack cannot remove it.

licence.description: SPDX licence id (e.g. CC-BY-4.0, CC0-1.0) or 'public-domain'.

learning.description: Education: what the whole adventure teaches.

presetVersion.description: Pinned on publish to the preset file's version (RULES_PRESETS_V1.md).

overrides.description: An RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch applied to the preset (RULES_PRESETS_V1.md 'Creator overrides'). The merged result must validate against rules_preset_v1.schema.json.

game.description: The wolfGame game whose stats, items and money rewards use. Empty = the region's own game. Value moves only when the adventure owner owns that game or the game owner linked this adventure (BRAIN_API_V1.md 'Value through wolfGame').

mode.description: ai: Wolf Mind talks and the AI Director runs, paid by the owner. none: written lines and rules only, costs nothing (plan 7.4). An 'ai' adventure falls back to 'none' by itself when the owner's credits or cap run out.

dailyCapCredits.description: Most WolfCredits this adventure may spend per UTC day (1 credit = 1 US cent of provider cost, rust_proxy build_jobs.rs:301-306). Default 100.

playerDailyTurns.description: AI talk turns per player per UTC day in this adventure.

freeChat.description: Players may type freely to AI characters. false = quick replies only (education default).

accuracy.description: Accuracy mode (education): characters answer only from sourceCards and say they do not know otherwise (WOLF_MIND_V1.md).

improvise.description: The AI Director may write new narration lines within a beat's rules. false = it only picks authored options.

translate.description: Characters answer in the session's language when it differs from the pack's (education 'Languages').

dailyChars.description: Most characters spoken aloud per UTC day (CPU and cost guard).

npcReputation.description: Track each cast member's opinion of each player (-100..100).

bands.description: Named ranges, low to high, e.g. Outlaw / Drifter / Upstanding. Used by conditions ('band') and shown on the honour bar.

scope.description: player: one value per player; party: one per party; world: one per region for this adventure (the 'shared world').

journal.description: Shown to the player on the Journal page with this label.

facing.description: Degrees, 0 = east, 90 = north (STORY v1 facing:, wolf_storyteller.lsl facingDeg).

pause.description: Seconds to wait at each point.

chests.description: Objects whose contents rewards may hand out (effect give_inventory). Bound in-world with wolfAdventureChest (REGION_HANDS_V1.md).

first.description: NPC first name (INPCModule.CreateNPC firstname). One word.

last.description: NPC last name (INPCModule.CreateNPC lastname). One word.

title.description: Shown above the name on the talk panel, e.g. 'Sheriff'.

look.description: appearance: a notecard ASSET holding the LLSD-XML appearance that osNpcSaveAppearance writes (OSSL_Api.cs:2950-2964 reads it with OSDParser.DeserializeLLSDXml + AvatarAppearance.Unpack). Empty = the grid's standard look (the region hands: hello defaultAppearance, else the NPC module's default avatar). dressedBy: the display name of whoever last gave this character their look through a look pad or 'Use what I'm wearing' (written by the brain). standard: true while the character wears the standard look (written by the brain when the region spawns it with no appearance; cleared when a look is given).

home.description: Spot id where the character stands when nothing else says.

persona.description: Who they are, how they speak. Read by Wolf Mind.

manner.description: Voice and manner for the writer and for TTS pacing.

neverReveal.description: Secrets. Checked on every AI reply (WOLF_MIND_V1.md 'Output checks').

neverSay.description: Words or phrases the character never uses (substring match, case-insensitive).

cards.description: Story card ids this character may know about (empty = every card not restricted to other cast).

idle.description: Written lines for 'not part of your current beat' (STORY v1 idle:). Picked in turn; also the non-AI fallback.

barks.description: Short scripted lines for crowds and moments (no AI).

id.description: A voice id from the brain's voice list (WOLF_MIND_V1.md 'Voices'), e.g. piper:en_GB-alan-medium.

schedule.description: Where they are by time of day (region time, hours 0-24). First matching entry wins; none = home.

absent.description: Not in the world at all during this time.

actions.description: The allow-list of actions Wolf Mind may propose for this character (WOLF_MIND_V1.md 'Actions'). Empty = say/emote only.

triggerIds.description: For fire_trigger: the ONLY trigger ids (type ai) this character may fire.

actor.description: This character is a wolfGame actor: targetable, has health, may be fought (REGION_HANDS_V1.md 'Director NPCs as wolfGame actors').

statBlock.description: 5e preset: a monster or NPC stat block id in the preset's data (RULES_PRESETS_V1.md). Other presets: a stat map.

respawn.description: Seconds after defeat before it may be spawned again; 0 = only by the story.

source.description: Imported from a Character Card (V2/V3): kept for the Studio's provenance line.

anim.description: An animation: a built-in name (e.g. stand, sit, dance1 - the viewer's default animations) or an animation asset UUID.

line.description: A written line. 'audio' is a sound asset UUID (pre-recorded, played at the speaker, no AI cost).

storyCard.description: Lore read by Wolf Mind only when a key appears in the conversation (AI Dungeon / Character Card character_book pattern).

cast.description: Only these characters know it (empty = all).

sourceCard.description: A cited fact for accuracy mode. Every reply that uses one shows its citation.

era.description: For the anachronism check: the latest year this card may speak about.

at.description: Spot id the group is placed round.

props.description: Inventory objects the hands rez from a bound chest (REGION_HANDS_V1.md 'Props').

despawnAfter.description: Seconds with no player within 64 m before it is removed.

combat.description: Start initiative/turn order when it spawns (rules preset combat.mode turns).

items.description: wolfGame items (IWolfGameModule.ItemAdd names, a-z0-9_ up to 24).

inventory.description: Second Life-style inventory items given from a bound chest (STORY v1 give steps).

once.description: Given once per player per adventure, ever (STORY v1: 'rewards are still given only once').

keyFacts.description: Source card ids the scene must cover.

xapiActivity.description: IRI for this scene/adventure as an xAPI Activity. Empty = the brain's default (BRAIN_API_V1.md 'xAPI').

type.description: choice = QTI qti-choice-interaction; text = qti-text-entry-interaction (auto-marked against 'accept'); essay = qti-extended-text-interaction (teacher marks).

accept.description: text items: accepted answers, compared trimmed and case-insensitive.

titleCard.description: Shown as a chapter card (stage 'title') when the act starts.

built.description: [GAME CARD 2026-10-18] false = a chapter in the outline that is not built yet (its beats are the outline's, each with its objective and a "Still to decide" way on). Absent = true.

shared.description: party mode 'both': this scene's world state (cast placement, props, world flags) is shared by every party on the region; per-party otherwise.

boxed.description: Read-aloud text, shown as a vignette on entering the scene.

entry.description: May the party enter this scene? Checked on goto_scene.

stage.description: The stage bundle applied all at once when the scene starts (plan lesson 3).

dismiss.description: Cast ids removed when the scene starts.

encounters.description: Encounter ids spawned with the scene (others are fired by effects or the GM).

intro.description: Opening staging for the players in the scene.

environment.description: A PARTIAL Wolf Environment document (format 1, wolfstorm php/wolf_env_lib.php; the same patch wolfEnvironmentSet sends). Applied to the scene's area scope by the brain through wolf_environment.php. Checked by we_normalise.

scope.description: Where 'environment' is written: the whole region, or the parcel at the scene area's centre. Needs the region holder's environment approval (BRAIN_API_V1.md enable_region). Music and sounds always reach only the party.

url.description: A stream or file for the party's viewers (the HUD 'stage' music cue).

main.description: [GAME CARD 2026-10-18] This beat is a step of the main quest. Main steps are in pack order (act, scene, beat).

kind.description: [GAME CARD 2026-10-18] The box's icon on the story map. Filled in by the brain when absent (wa_beat_kind); an author's own choice is kept.

marker.description: Spot id for the map / world marker.

onDuty.description: Characters with a job in this beat, and what each wants (Wolf Mind's beat layer).

lines.description: Written lines for this beat (non-AI mode speaks these; AI mode may use them).

replies.description: Quick replies shown on the talk panel.

hints.description: Shown when the party has not moved on for 'after' seconds (the rules-only recovery; the AI Director adds more in ai mode).

by.description: Cast id who says it (else the narrator).

recover.description: If the party leaves the scene's area for this long, run these effects (send someone to fetch them, re-stage) - never fail them (plan lesson 8).

aiNotes.description: Private guidance for the AI Director in this beat.

by.description: Cast id who asks (else the narrator). Shown as a vignette.

who.description: player: each player chooses for themself; leader: the party leader chooses for the party; vote: majority of party members within 'sec'.

on.description: Every trigger type. The fields each type needs are in ADVENTURE_PACK_V1.md 'Triggers' and are checked by the brain.

object.description: touch/sit: the object NAME; touch also matches an object whose root description is 'touch: <name>' (STORY v1 spots, REGION_HANDS_V1.md section 7).

intent.description: say: words that count (any of them, whole words, case-insensitive), matched by the brain without AI; in ai mode Wolf Mind may also report an intent id equal to this trigger's id.

sec.description: timer: seconds since the beat started.

check.description: roll: a check id from the rules preset.

result.description: roll: which outcome fires this trigger.

scene.description: scene: fires when the party enters this scene.

who.description: any: one player is enough; all: every party member present; leader: the party leader.

next.description: Beat id to move the party to after 'do' (same scene or another).

label.description: GM Console button text for 'gm' triggers.

effect.description: One step. Exactly one operation key. Run in order; 'wait' pauses the rest (the brain schedules them).

decision.description: Show this decision's options on the card.

follow.description: Follow the triggering player (or stop following with false).

handout.description: Handout id given to the party (Journal > Handouts).

quiz.description: Quiz id shown to the player(s).

join.description: A companion (STORY_FIRST_DESIGN.md section 9): the character walks with the players from here, following the triggering player or the party's leader, until the beat `until` (if given) or a `leave`. At most 2 per party.

until.description: Beat id: the companion leaves by itself when the party enters it.

leave.description: A companion stops walking with the players and goes.

battle.description: [M4] Battle id: the fight starts (COMBAT_V1.md section 1.3).

signal.description: [M6] A signal to the adventure's listening scripts (STORY_FIRST_DESIGN.md section 6): the event line signal|<agent>|<adventure>|<name>|<data> (REGION_HANDS_V1.md section 8), for the triggering player, else each of the party. data: at most 240 bytes.

condition.description: A JSON condition tree (no string expressions). ADVENTURE_PACK_V1.md 'Conditions'.

castRep.description: Cast id (that character's opinion of the player).

band.description: with rep/honour: in this band id.

visited.description: Beat or scene id: visit count (Ink-style).

hour.description: Region hours [from, to], wrapping past midnight when from > to.

kind.description: [GAME CARD 2026-10-18] win, lose or other (absent = other).

if.description: Reached automatically when true at a beat boundary (else only by an 'end' effect).

outcome.description: For xAPI/LTI: completed only, passed or failed (education).

enemy.description: [M4] An enemy: anything or anyone the players fight (COMBAT_V1.md section 1.1). Only a name is needed: every number has a default (the ready-made enemy of the same name, else an ordinary foe of the rules preset).

name.description: Also the NPC's name tag: the first word is the first name, the second (or 'Enemy') the last name.

look.description: npc: an NPC wearing an appearance notecard ('' = the default avatar); cast: a character of the story turns on them; object: an object rezzed from a bound chest.

template.description: The ready-made enemy its numbers came from (enemy_templates), for the Studio.

fleeAt.description: flees: runs off at or below this per cent of its health.

loot.description: A reward parcel given when it is beaten.

battle.description: [M4] A battle: a box whose ways on are 'if they win' (won) and 'if they lose' (lost) (COMBAT_V1.md section 1.2). Started by the effect battle.

at.description: Spot id the enemies appear round (else the box's marker, else beside the party leader).

onLoss.description: retry: everyone back to full health, it starts again after 10 s; continue: the lost way on decides.

reward.description: A reward parcel for every player there at the victory.

share.description: Who gets an enemy's loot: each player there, or the one who beat it.

draughts.description: Healing draughts each player has in this battle.
